subject: Model shortlist & fit summary — Aurelia Health POC
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@aureliahealth.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — model fit questions

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo earlier — the team found the latency numbers encouraging. A few quick follow-ups from our ML/arch group so we can decide which models to surface for the POC: 

- Primary objectives: high clinical QA (precision on extractive tasks), safe hallucination behavior, and predictable latency for 512-token responses.
- Constraints: PHI will be passed in prompts (we'll sign the DPA), and budget target is ~$0.60 per 1k tokens for inference.
- Asks: can you share a short recommended shortlist (2–4 models) with a one-line tradeoff summary (quality vs latency vs cost), the prompt set you'll run on for our eval, and any benchmark links?

We'd also like a sense of operational options — hosted vs dedicated pool vs private — and whether any of these require additional work to keep PHI handling compliant.

Can you get this over by EOD tomorrow? We're targeting an internal sync Monday to pick the POC model.

Thanks,
Sofia
Director, AI Platform
Aurelia Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — model fit questions

Hi Sofia — great questions, thanks for the clear constraints. I captured a compact shortlist below and attached the prompt set and our preliminary benchmark CSV (small-scale runs on your sample). High level first, then next steps.

Recommended shortlist (2–3 candidates):

1) redwood-lite-13b-q4 (quantized)
   - Quality: Strong for extraction and instruction tasks; slightly softer on generative creativity.
   - Latency: ~85ms/token on a single A10G-equivalent; fits 512-token SLO comfortably with continuous batching.
   - Cost: Low — estimated $0.32 / 1k tokens in hosted mode with bin-packing.
   - Risk/regression note: quantization can increase rare-token errors; recommend a small eval on 20 edge-case clinical prompts.

2) redstone-70b-pt (sparse-kernel tuned)
   - Quality: Best-in-class on clinical reasoning in our internal evals.
   - Latency: ~140ms/token on V100-class hardware; requires larger instance or dedicated pool for tight latency.
   - Cost: Mid — estimated $0.78 / 1k tokens in hosted; Dedicated reserved pools reduce per-token below $0.6 depending on commit.
   - Risk: Larger model increases tail latencies; KV cache sizing matters for long conversation state.

3) falcon-40b-instruct (open-source baseline) — conditional
   - Quality: Good baseline; lower hallucination control than redstone models on clinical prompts.
   - Latency: ~110ms/token.
   - Cost: ~$0.45 / 1k tokens (hosted).
   - Use-case: good safety/latency compromise if you want open-source stack for auditability.

Attachments included: aurelia_prompt_set_v1.txt (prompt suite we ran), aurelia_demo_benchmarks.csv (per-model latency/QA scores). Also added a short readme in the Drive link.

Operational notes:
- Hosted API: fastest to start; we can enable customer-managed KMS and dedicated logging for PHI retention controls.
- Dedicated pool: recommended for consistent tail latency and cost predictability; pricing depends on commit length.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): available if your security team requires air-gapped processing — will add onboarding time (~3–4 weeks).

Suggested immediate next steps:
- We run the enclosed prompt set (attached) over a 200-case audit set you provide (or we can redact/test on your anonymized subset) — deliverable: detailed per-prompt QA and hallucination flags (3 business days).
- I can schedule a 30-min technical sync with our infra lead (Vivek) and your ML engineer to confirm latency targets and pool sizing.
- If you want cost below $0.60/1k for redstone-70b, discuss a 6–12 month dedicated commit with our pricing team.

Link to benchmark folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AureliaPOCBenchmarks
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/companies/12345

I'll wait for your preferred time for the tech sync. If helpful, I've flagged two rows in the CSV for the clinical-edge prompts where redstone shows meaningful lift — see column "edge_delta".

Best,
Rachel Kim

rachel_kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Rachel — quick notes from infra perspective (cc'ing Laura for pricing):

- For redstone-70b-pt to hit 512-token p95 latency target you'll want a dedicated pool or a guaranteed slice on a multi-tenant node; burst can cause 20–30% p95 variance.
- Quantized redwood-lite-13b-q4 looks ideal for initial POC to keep cost under their $0.60/1k target; we'll run a dry-run with affinity settings and measure tail.
- I'll draft a short spec for KV cache sizes depending on conversation length — that will help them avoid tail latency surprises.

Happy to join the tech sync; propose Monday 10am PT.

—Vivek
Head of Infrastructure
